title: Costa Rican Beaches & Tourism Hotspots
shortDescription: Handpicked beaches and must‑see destinations across Costa Rica.
longDescription: From Caribbean palms to Pacific surf breaks and volcanic highlands, Costa Rica offers diverse destinations. This guide curates single‑focus beach and hotspot entries with highlights, practical tips, and responsible travel notes. Learners can compare ecosystems, seasons, and activities while planning low‑impact trips that benefit local communities.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Compact park where rainforest meets white‑sand coves.

sections.heading: Highlights
sections.content: Sloths, monkeys, short scenic trails, viewpoints.

sections.heading: Practical Info

sections.heading: Responsible Travel
